__doc__: Curator supplements to the INAO aires-communes CSVs — see scripts/_lib/aires.py (apply_supplements). The CSV rows of an aire can predate the cahier des charges in force (the IGP Cévennes rows carry Date MAJ 2012; the cahier homologated in 2024 adds 40 Lozère communes), so a commune-union record drew the old aire. Keyed by record slug: `aire` + `ida` (the CSV's `Aire géographique` label and IDA the communes are added to), `communes` {INSEE (IGN AdminExpress, current): name} — communes the homologated cahier lists and the CSV lacks, `not_drawn` {INSEE: why} — cahier communes left out because only a part of the commune is in the aire and no public polygon of that part is in the build, `reason` (what the cahier says, with its publication), `source` (the files the claim rests on), `verified`. Only a cahier published in the Bulletin officiel (homologated) is pinned, never a PNO project. A pinned commune the CSV carries again is STALE: it is not added twice, stage 04 says so and tests/test_aires_supplements.py fails — re-verify against the new CSV release and drop the pin.

cevennes.reason: Cahier des charges section 4.1, « Pour le département de la Lozère : » — 40 communes (code officiel géographique 2023) beside the Gard list; section 7.1 opens « Le vignoble des Cévennes est situé dans les départements du Gard et de la Lozère ». Published in the BO du MASA on 8 August 2024 (arrêté at JORF 4 August 2024). The INAO IGP aires CSV (release 2025-10-09) still carries the 236 Gard rows of 14 September 2012 and no Lozère row, so the map drew a Gard-only Cévennes — the boundary flag of 2026-09-29 (fr, z7.2). The Gard list of the cahier equals the CSV rows (pre-merger names apart). Massegros Causses Gorges is in the aire « pour la partie correspondant au territoire de la commune déléguée Les Vignes » only: pinned since 2026-11-13 as the former commune Les Vignes under its own code (48195), whose outline geo.api.gouv.fr still serves — until then nothing was drawn for it, IGN's commune layer having no polygon for a commune déléguée. BO Agri's title search of 2026-11-13 lists no cahier of the IGP newer than the one of 8 August 2024.
cevennes.source: raw/inao/cahier-extracted/cevennes.json (sections 4 and 7; BO Agri document_administratif-239e6295-725b-497b-b2fc-12d1f78383e4); raw/inao/igp-aires-communes.csv (Aire géographique = Cévennes, IDA 2217, Date MAJ 2012-09-14, 236 rows, all CI 30xxx); raw/ign/communes.geojson (names → INSEE); raw/ign/communes-associees-deleguees.geojson (Les Vignes, 48195, commune déléguée of 48094)
